Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> concerning Edom<WH0123>; We have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> a rumour<WH08052> from the LORD<WH03068>, and an ambassador<WH06735> is sent<WH07971><WTH8795> among the heathen<WH01471>, Arise<WH06965><WTH8798> ye, and let us rise up<WH06965><WTH8799> against her in battle<WH04421>.

The pride<WH02087> of thine heart<WH03820> hath deceived<WH05377><WTH8689> thee, thou that dwellest<WH07931><WTH8802> in the clefts<WH02288> of the rock<WH05553>, whose habitation<WH03427><WTH8800> <FI>is<Fi>  high<WH04791>; that saith<WH0559><WTH8802> in his heart<WH03820>, Who shall bring me down<WH03381><WTH8686> to the ground<WH0776>?

Though thou exalt<WH01361><WTH8686> <FI>thyself<Fi> as the eagle<WH05404>, and though thou set<WH07760><WTH8800> thy nest<WH07064> among the stars<WH03556>, thence will I bring thee down<WH03381><WTH8686>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.

If thieves<WH01590> came<WH0935><WTH8804> to thee, if robbers<WH07703><WTH8802> by night<WH03915>, (how art thou cut off<WH01820><WTH8738>!) would they not have stolen<WH01589><WTH8799> till they had enough<WH01767>? if the grapegatherers<WH01219><WTH8802> came<WH0935><WTH8804> to thee, would they not leave<WH07604><WTH8686> <FI>some<Fi> grapes<WH05955>? <RF>some...: or, gleanings?<Rf>
How are <FI>the things<Fi> of Esau<WH06215> searched out<WH02664><WTH8738>! <FI>how<Fi> are his hidden<WH04710> things sought up<WH01158><WTH8738>!

All the men<WH0582> of thy confederacy<WH01285> have brought<WH07971><WTH8765> thee <FI>even<Fi> to the border<WH01366>: the men<WH0582> that were at peace<WH07965> with thee have deceived<WH05377><WTH8689> thee, <FI>and<Fi> prevailed<WH03201><WTH8804> against thee; <FI>they that eat<Fi> thy bread<WH03899> have laid<WH07760><WTH8799> a wound<WH04204> under thee: <FI>there is<Fi> none understanding<WH08394> in him. <RF>that were...: Heb. of thy peace<Rf> <RF>they...: Heb. the men of thy bread<Rf> <RF>in him: or, of it<Rf>

Shall I not in that day<WH03117>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, even destroy<WH06><WTH8689> the wise<WH02450> <FI>men<Fi> out of Edom<WH0123>, and understanding<WH08394> out of the mount<WH02022> of Esau<WH06215>?

And thy mighty<WH01368> <FI>men<Fi> , O Teman<WH08487>, shall be dismayed<WH02865><WTH8804>, to the end that every one<WH0376> of the mount<WH02022> of Esau<WH06215> may be cut off<WH03772><WTH8735> by slaughter<WH06993>.<CM>
For <FI>thy<Fi> violence<WH02555> against thy brother<WH0251> Jacob<WH03290> shame<WH0955> shall cover<WH03680><WTH8762> thee, and thou shalt be cut off<WH03772><WTH8738> for ever<WH05769>.

In the day<WH03117> that thou stoodest<WH05975><WTH8800> on the other side, in the day<WH03117> that the strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> carried away captive<WH07617><WTH8800> his forces<WH02428>, and foreigners<WH05237> entered<WH0935><WTH8804> into his gates<WH08179>, and cast<WH03032><WTH8804> lots<WH01486> upon Jerusalem<WH03389>, even thou <FI>wast<Fi> as one<WH0259> of them. <RF>captive...: or, his substance<Rf>

But thou shouldest not have looked<WH07200><WTH8799> on the day<WH03117> of thy brother<WH0251> in the day<WH03117> that he became a stranger<WH05235>; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced<WH08055><WTH8799> over the children<WH01121> of Judah<WH03063> in the day<WH03117> of their destruction<WH06><WTH8800>; neither shouldest thou have spoken<WH06310> proudly<WH01431><WTH8686> in the day<WH03117> of distress<WH06869>. <RF>spoken...: Heb. magnified thy mouth<Rf>

Neither shouldest thou have stood<WH05975><WTH8799> in the crossway<WH06563>, to cut off<WH03772><WTH8687> those of his that did escape<WH06412>; neither shouldest thou have delivered up<WH05462><WTH8686> those of his that did remain<WH08300> in the day<WH03117> of distress<WH06869>. <RF>delivered up: or, shut up<Rf>

For the day<WH03117> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> near<WH07138> upon all the heathen<WH01471>: as thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804>, it shall be done<WH06213><WTH8735> unto thee: thy reward<WH01576> shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> upon thine own head<WH07218>.

For as ye have drunk<WH08354><WTH8804> upon my holy<WH06944> mountain<WH02022>, <FI>so<Fi> shall all the heathen<WH01471> drink<WH08354><WTH8799> continually<WH08548>, yea, they shall drink<WH08354><WTH8804>, and they shall swallow down<WH03886><WTH8804>, and they shall be as though they had not<WH03808> been. <RF>swallow...: or, sup up<Rf><CM>

But upon mount<WH02022> Zion<WH06726> shall be deliverance<WH06413>, and there shall be holiness<WH06944>; and the house<WH01004> of Jacob<WH03290> shall possess<WH03423><WTH8804> their possessions<WH04180>. <RF>deliverance: or, they that escape<Rf> <RF>there...: or, it shall be holy<Rf>
